class.name: OpenWorldTreeGenerator3D
class.brief_description: Generates deterministic stylized tree LOD meshes with optional cartoon wind preview.
class.description: [OpenWorldTreeGenerator3D] builds archetype-specific static trees from [member generation_profile] and [member seed]. A generation pass creates LOD0 and, when enabled, simplified LOD1 and LOD2 meshes. Every mesh keeps trunk/root/branch surface 0 and foliage surface 1. Vertex colors store a shared wind contract: R is height-based global bend, G is branch or frond secondary bend, B is foliage flutter, and A is a stable phase. Enabling [member wind_enabled] assigns built-in cartoon wind materials for preview and baking. Custom materials can consume the same vertex channels. [method create_baked_variant] copies every generated LOD and its transition distances into an [OpenWorldTreeVariant]. Use [member preview_lod] to force a particular generated LOD in the editor.

method.name: clear_generated_tree
method.description: Clears all generated LOD meshes from this node.

method.name: create_baked_variant
method.description: Creates an unsaved variant containing deep copies of generated LOD0, LOD1, and LOD2 plus the configured distances.

method.name: generate_tree
method.description: Rebuilds all enabled LOD meshes deterministically and emits [signal tree_generated] with LOD0.

method.name: get_generated_lod_mesh
method.description: Returns generated LOD index 0 through 2, or [code]null[/code] when that level is disabled or not generated.

method.name: get_generated_mesh
method.description: Returns generated LOD0 for compatibility with the phase 1 and phase 2 API.

method.name: get_generated_support_graph
method.description: Returns LOD-independent trunk and primary branch centerlines captured during the last generation pass.

method.name: get_lod_statistics
method.description: Returns [code]lod[/code], [code]available[/code], [code]surfaces[/code], [code]vertices[/code], [code]triangles[/code], and [code]aabb[/code] for one generated level.

method.name: randomize_seed
method.description: Chooses a random seed and generates another deterministic variation.

signal.description: Emitted after enabled LOD meshes are rebuilt. The argument is LOD0.
